model_fitness.best_available_model: Patient-derived myogenic cells carrying the exon 55 PTC (MyoD-transdifferentiated fibroblasts/urine-derived cells or iPSC-derived myotubes), used with delivery-maximizing transfection (nucleofection) rather than free uptake; paired with the published mdx52 + 45-55 PMO cocktail protocol as the in vivo benchmark (EVIDENCE, supportive: PMID 30171548). Patient-derived iPSC work already shows the 45-55-deleted dystrophin product is expressed and detectable across three distinct DMD mutations (EVIDENCE, supportive: PMID 37625413).
model_fitness.captures_relevant_mechanism: Yes for the gating question: whether ~10-11 steric-block ASOs can co-occupy the same nascent DMD pre-mRNA often enough to yield a fully 45-55-skipped in-frame transcript. Endogenous full-length DMD splicing plus the exon 55 PTC and its NMD behaviour are present in cis, which mdx52 cannot provide (INFERENCE, supportive). The mouse arm answers the separate in vivo distribution question, especially heart (EVIDENCE: PMID 30171548).
model_fitness.captures_relevant_cell_type: Partial. Skeletal myotubes are the primary Dp427m target. Cardiomyocytes - whose failure dominates mortality and where naked PMO uptake is near zero (INFERENCE, contradictory: PMID 28398005) - need same-patient hiPSC-cardiomyocytes or the mdx52 arm. Satellite cells, which ASOs do not durably correct, are not modelled (INFERENCE, contradictory).
model_fitness.measurable_phenotype: Molecular: fraction of DMD transcripts fully exon-45-55-skipped (allele-resolved long-read or exon44-56 nested RT-PCR with amplicon sequencing to exclude partial skips), total DMD mRNA abundance (NMD efficiency, a listed major unknown), and internally deleted dystrophin by Western/immunocytochemistry. No reliable contraction or force readout in myotubes.
model_fitness.important_limitations: No mechanical loading, no fibrosis/fat compartment, no cardiac or CNS compartment; transfection deliberately bypasses the real pharmacological bottleneck, so a positive result proves only that the splicing geometry is attainable, not that it is attainable at clinical muscle exposures. Conversely a negative result under saturating intracellular ASO is strongly informative, since in vivo exposure can only be lower (INFERENCE, supportive).

plan.critical_question: Under delivery-saturating conditions in the patient's own myogenic cells, what fraction of DMD transcripts becomes FULLY exon-45-55-skipped and in-frame - and does a smaller frame-neutral block containing exon 55 achieve the same with fewer oligos? This multiplicative co-occupancy question is unanswered in the retrieved literature, where the only cocktail data are mdx52 mouse (PMID 30171548).
plan.proposed_experiment:
Step 0 (in silico, days, near-zero cost; must precede synthesis): from the patient's own DMD transcript, enumerate every contiguous exon block containing exon 55 that is frame-neutral when joined to its flanking exons, ranked by oligo count; smaller windows are pharmacologically far cheaper and must be exhausted before committing to the 11-exon geometry. Systematic multi-exon-skip enumeration has precedent (EVIDENCE, supportive: PMID 39596689).

Step 1 (the decision experiment, ~3-4 months): establish patient-derived myotubes. First measure baseline DMD mRNA abundance and allele-specific decay versus control to settle NMD efficiency - heavy degradation would make every transcript-dependent strategy, including readthrough, template-limited (HYPOTHESIS, not_studied). Then nucleofect at saturating and titrated doses: (a) full ~11-ASO 45-55 cocktail, (b) best smaller frame-neutral cocktail from Step 0, (c) single exon-53 ASO as positive control for assay sensitivity and cell competence, (d) scrambled control. Read out by long-read (or exon44-56 nested RT-PCR + amplicon) sequencing quantifying fully vs partially vs unskipped transcripts; secondary internally deleted dystrophin by Western at 7-10 days.

Step 2 (gated on Step 1): run the mdx52 systemic PMO cocktail protocol (PMID 30171548) with a pre-specified, equally weighted cardiac endpoint - fully skipped transcript and dystrophin in left ventricle and diaphragm, not only tibialis anterior - to test the delivery ceiling implied by terminated programs (EVIDENCE, contradictory: NCT03907072 suvodirsen lack of efficacy; NCT06079736/NCT06833931 PGN-EDO51 withdrawn).
plan.model: Patient-derived myotubes carrying the exon 55 PTC (MyoD-transdifferentiated fibroblasts or urine-derived cells, or iPSC-derived myotubes), with a gated follow-on arm in mdx52 mice using the published systemic 45-55 PMO cocktail protocol (PMID 30171548).
plan.primary_readout: Percentage of DMD transcripts fully skipped across the entire targeted block (all internal exons absent, exon 44 joined in frame to exon 56) by allele-resolved long-read sequencing; co-primary is the partial-skip spectrum, which directly reports whether co-occupancy is rate-limiting. Secondary: internally deleted dystrophin level relative to healthy control myotubes, and baseline DMD mRNA abundance as the NMD readout.
plan.supportive_result: At saturating intracellular ASO, fully skipped transcript exceeds ~20-30% with detectable internally deleted dystrophin, and the partial-skip ladder is shallow (co-occupancy not catastrophically limiting) - ideally with fewer than 11 oligos. With a Step 2 mdx52 arm showing non-trivial cardiac skipping, this justifies investing in peptide-conjugated or receptor-targeted delivery chemistry.
plan.negative_result: Fully skipped transcript stays in the low single-digit percent, or the sequencing shows a steep partial-skip ladder dominated by transcripts missing only 2-4 exons, even at delivery-saturating dose while the exon-53 control skips efficiently. That makes the multiplicative penalty concrete and, since in vivo exposure is strictly lower, caps the program below the already-marginal approved-PMO benchmark (INFERENCE, contradictory: PMID 28398005). Near-absent DMD transcript from efficient NMD would further reduce available template.
plan.decision_enabled: Go/no-go on the entire multiskip-ASO modality for this patient at the cost of one in-silico analysis plus one cell experiment, before any 11-component CMC/impurity/toxicology package is contemplated (an unprecedented regulatory object - INFERENCE, contradictory). Supportive: proceed to the gated mdx52 arm and begin delivery-chemistry partnering with the smallest frame-neutral block as lead. Negative: deprioritize multiskip ASO and redirect to the parallel question the dossier flags - whether this PTC leaves enough stable transcript for a readthrough agent - which the same cell line and same mRNA-abundance readout answer with no extra model build.
